evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'we might need to ask you ten to fifteen questions. Would that be fine?' and 'I'm all good with my estimate ma'am' but never explicitly frames the 10-15 minute promise + 'quote you can depend on' + wait for yes. Jumps into detailed probing without the full framing.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name (Jen Gong), moving day (Friday the 30th), route (10402 Town and Country Way, Houston to 5310 Indian Shore Lane, Houston), and size (one bedroom apartment to two-story house) all confirmed.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep launches directly into logistics probing (balcony/garage, floor level, elevator access) without first asking 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (apartment to house), floor/stories (second floor to two-story), rooms (one bedroom to four/using two upstairs), walking distance (10-15 steps from elevator to truck, 1-2 school buses from apartment to elevator), special items (bed frame needing disassembly, two glass-shelf cabinets, no appliances), no additional stops. All seven logistics items covered.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: 'How about packing, do you need help packing or you're gonna wrap or pack everything?' Customer declines, saying she's moving everything beforehand.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: 'How about boxes typically for a bedroom or apartment to your size box count is within fifteen to 25 how many total number of boxes do you think are we going to move for you approximately?' Customer says zero boxes.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep provides range ($510 to $714 for 2.5-3.5 hours) and personalizes to the specific move: 'Since we're going to be moving you from the second floor anticipating a bit of a walk from your apartment down to the truck into a two story house. I'm estimating the move to take only around two and a half to three and a half hours.'
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep discloses hourly rate ($204/hour for two movers, 26-foot truck), states 'no hidden fee, no credit card fee, no transportation fees, no terrible fees' and explains '2.5 hour minimum, once we go over the minimum the time will be prorated in fifteen minutes. Increment.' Also clarifies 'the time will only start as soon as we are on site.'
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Rep never asks 'Does that feel fair?' after the estimate. Customer raises a follow-up concern about experienced movers, which rep addresses, but no check-in on the pricing fairness itself.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: 'We also have an on time guarantee. So, if the movers arrive late, you start to get discount on your final bill ma'am.' Covers discount terms in recognizable form.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: 'Once you book this move, you're also gonna get up to $2,000 valve free evaluation coverage. So, if anything gets damaged or broken during the move, you can just give us a call to file a claim for it. It's gonna be zero deductible... gonna repair, replace or reimburse that within three to five business days.' Covers amount, no deductible, no fine print framing, and built into the rate.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or similar. Moves directly to availability/booking without confirming the two promises address customer concerns.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep asks 'Before I go over pricing structure and estimate, do you have any question any clarification regarding the moving process in general?' This is generic and gets immediate 'no' without genuine probing for remaining concerns. Later, customer raises concern about experienced movers, which rep addresses, but no formal Section 6 check for final concerns before closing.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Never asked. No version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: 'So would you like our help with your move?' Asked plainly without built-in out.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: 'Once you book this move, you're also gonna get up to $2,000 valve free evaluation coverage' and 'that's gonna be no deposit required and always member with Einstein. You only pay after the actual move is done' — rate-lock and no-deposit messaging provided.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Date (Friday the 30th, 8:30-9:00am), phone number (not captured on call), arrival window (8:30-9:00am), crew size (two movers, implied from $204/hour rate), addresses (confirmed: 10402 Town and Country Way to 5310 Indian Shore Lane), notes for crew (addressed concern about experienced movers, but not formally captured). Confirmation email promised. Partial — missing phone number capture on the call itself.

top_strength: Arden gathered comprehensive logistics details (property type, floor/stories, room count, walking distance, special items, box count) and delivered both pricing promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) in clear, complete language that addressed the core move details.
coaching_note: Ask 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' early in Section 2 before diving into logistics probing, and add a genuine 'What's still concerning you?' check in Section 6 instead of the generic 'Any questions?' — these unlock deeper customer trust and reveal hidden objections.
